comments.author: @travellives
comments.text: The stark contrast between million-dollar superyachts docked in Tivat and elderly villagers stacking firewood against winter storms in Žabljak is deeply thought-provoking

replies.author: @TOURGUIDE-05
replies.text: It really highlights the unique and challenging regional contrasts found throughout Montenegro.

comments.author: @Travel.Documentary.365
comments.text: Montenegro feels much bigger than it looks on the map. Every part of the country seems to have a completely different way of life❤

replies.author: @TOURGUIDE-05
replies.text: It’s truly incredible how much diversity is packed into such a small area! ❤️
